svg.title: teamplanOS — All of a company's HR work in one place

g.text: All of a company's HR work in one place
Time tracking, leave, overtime, expenses and payroll
in one place. Employees clock in by scanning a QR
code at the door; the accountant files returns straight
from the system. Many companies share one platform,
